verses.kjv: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.modern: Now King David was old and advanced in years. And although they covered him with clothes, he could not get warm.

verses.kjv: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.modern: Therefore his servants said to him, "Let a young woman be sought for my lord the king, and let her wait on the king and be in his service. Let her lie in your arms, that my lord the king may be warm."

verses.kjv: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.modern: So they sought for a beautiful young woman throughout all the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

verses.kjv: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.modern: The young woman was very beautiful. She was of service to the king and attended to him, but the king had no relations with her.

verses.kjv: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.modern: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, "I will be king." And he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.kjv: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
verses.modern: His father had never at any time displeased him by asking, "Why have you done thus and so?" He was also a very handsome man. He was born next after Absalom.

verses.kjv: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
verses.modern: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest. And they followed Adonijah and helped him.

verses.kjv: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.modern: But Zadok the priest and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada and Nathan the prophet and Shimei and Rei and David's mighty men were not with Adonijah.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:
verses.modern: Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened cattle by the Serpent's Stone, which is beside En-rogel. He invited all his brothers, the king's sons. All the royal officials of Judah,

verses.kjv: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.modern: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the mighty men or Solomon his brother.

verses.kjv: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
verses.modern: Then Nathan said to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, "Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king and David our lord does not know it?

verses.kjv: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.modern: Now therefore come, let me give you advice, that you may save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.

verses.kjv: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.modern: Go in at once to King David and say to him, 'Did you not, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, "Solomon your son shall reign after me. He shall sit on my throne"? Why then is Adonijah king?'"

verses.kjv: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
verses.modern: While you are still talking there with the king, I also will come in after you and confirm your words."

verses.kjv: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.modern: So Bathsheba went to the king in his chamber (now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was attending to the king).

verses.kjv: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
verses.modern: Bathsheba bowed and paid homage to the king, and the king said, "What do you desire?"

verses.kjv: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.modern: She said to Him, "My lord, You swore to Your servant by the LORD Your God, saying, 'Solomon your son shall reign after me. He shall sit on my throne.'

verses.kjv: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
verses.modern: Now, see, Adonijah is king, although you, my lord the king, do not know it.

verses.kjv: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.modern: He has sacrificed oxen, fattened cattle, and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the commander of the army, but Solomon your servant he has not invited.

verses.kjv: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.modern: Now, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, to tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

verses.kjv: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
verses.modern: Otherwise it will come to pass, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be counted offenders."

verses.kjv: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.modern: While she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

verses.kjv: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.modern: They told the king, "Here is Nathan the prophet." And when he came in before the king, he bowed before the king with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.modern: Nathan said, "My lord the king, have you said, 'Adonijah shall reign after me. He shall sit on my throne'?

verses.kjv: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
verses.modern: For he has gone down this day and has sacrificed oxen, fattened cattle, and sheep in abundance, and has invited all the king's sons, the commanders of the army, and Abiathar the priest. And look, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, 'Long live King Adonijah!'

verses.kjv: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
verses.modern: But me, your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon he has not invited.

verses.kjv: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.modern: Has this thing been brought about by my lord the king and you have not told your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?"

verses.kjv: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
verses.modern: Then King David answered, "Call Bathsheba to me." So she came into the king's presence and stood before the king.

verses.kjv: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.modern: The king swore, saying, "As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of every adversity,

verses.kjv: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.modern: As I swore to You by the LORD, the God of Israel, saying, 'Solomon your son shall reign after me. He shall sit on my throne in my place,' even so will I do this day."

verses.kjv: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.modern: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground and paid homage to the king and said, "May my lord King David live forever!"

verses.kjv: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.modern: King David said, "Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada." So they came before the king.

verses.kjv: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
verses.modern: The king said to them, "Take with you the servants of your lord and have Solomon my son ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

verses.kjv: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
verses.modern: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet there anoint him king over Israel. Then blow the trumpet and say, 'Long live King Solomon!'

verses.kjv: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
verses.modern: You shall then come up after him. He shall come and sit on my throne, for he shall be king in my place. And I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah."

verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
verses.modern: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, "Amen! May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, say so.

verses.kjv: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.modern: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David."

verses.kjv: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.modern: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David's mule and brought him to Gihon.

verses.kjv: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.modern: There Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the trumpet. All the people said, "Long live King Solomon!"

verses.kjv: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.modern: All the people went up after him, playing on pipes and rejoicing with great joy, so that the earth was split by their noise.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.modern: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they finished eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, "What does this uproar in the city mean?"

verses.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.modern: While he was still speaking, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came. And Adonijah said, "Come in, for you are a worthy man and bring good news."

verses.kjv: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.modern: Jonathan answered Adonijah, "No, for our lord King David has made Solomon king,

verses.kjv: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
verses.modern: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites. And they had him ride on the king's mule.

verses.kjv: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
verses.modern: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon. They have gone up from there rejoicing, so that the city is in an uproar. That is the noise that you have heard.

verses.kjv: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.modern: Solomon sits on the royal throne.

verses.kjv: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.modern: Moreover, the king's servants came to congratulate our lord King David, saying, 'May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than yours, and make his throne greater than your throne.' And the king bowed himself on the bed.

verses.kjv: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
verses.modern: The king also said, 'Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has granted someone to sit on my throne this day, my own eyes seeing it.' "

verses.kjv: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.modern: Then all the guests of Adonijah trembled and rose, and each went his own way.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.modern: Adonijah feared Solomon. So he arose and went and took hold of the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.modern: Then it was told Solomon, " Adonijah fears King Solomon, for he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, 'Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.' "

verses.kjv: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.modern: Solomon said, "If he proves to be a worthy man, not one of his hairs shall fall to the earth, but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die."

verses.kjv: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.modern: So King Solomon sent. They brought him down from the altar. And he came and paid homage to King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, "Go to your house."

chapters.summary: King David was old and feeble, and his son Adonijah attempted to seize the throne with the support of Joab and Abiathar. Bathsheba and Nathan intervened, and David ordered Solomon to be anointed king at Gihon; Adonijah's supporters scattered.

verses.kjv: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.modern: When David's time to die drew near, he commanded Solomon his son, saying,

verses.kjv: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.modern: "I am about to go the way of all the earth. Be strong, and show yourself a man,

verses.kjv: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
verses.modern: Keep the charge of the LORD Your God, walking in His ways and keeping His statutes, His commandments, His rules. His testimonies, as it is written in the Law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever You turn,

verses.kjv: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
verses.modern: That the LORD may establish His word that He spoke concerning me, saying, 'If Your sons pay close attention to their way, to walk before me in faithfulness with all their heart and with all their soul, You shall not lack a man on the throne of Israel.'

verses.kjv: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
verses.modern: Moreover, You also know what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, how he dealt with the two commanders of the armies of Israel, Abner the son of Ner, and Amasa the son of Jether, whom He killed, putting in time of peace blood that had been shed in war, and putting the blood of war on the belt around His waist and on the sandals on His feet.

verses.kjv: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.modern: Act therefore according to Your wisdom, but do not let His gray head go down to the grave in peace.

verses.kjv: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
verses.modern: But deal loyally with the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, for with such loyalty they met me when I fled from Absalom your brother.

verses.kjv: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
verses.modern: There is also with You Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjaminite from Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse on the day when I went to Mahanaim. But when He came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to Him by the LORD, saying, 'I will not put You to death with the sword.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
verses.modern: Now therefore do not hold Him guiltless, for You are a wise man. You will know what You ought to do to Him, and You shall bring His gray head down with blood to the grave."

verses.kjv: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.modern: Then David slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David.

verses.kjv: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The time that David reigned over Israel was forty years. He reigned seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.modern: So Solomon sat on the throne of David his father. His kingdom was firmly established.

verses.kjv: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.modern: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, "Do you come peaceably?" He said, "Peaceably."

verses.kjv: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
verses.modern: Then he said, "I have something to say to you." She said, "Speak."

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.
verses.modern: He said, "You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel fully expected me to reign. However, the kingdom has turned about and become my brother's, for it was His from the LORD.

verses.kjv: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.modern: Now I have one request to make of You; do not refuse me." She said to Him, "Speak."

verses.kjv: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.modern: He said, "Please ask King Solomon—he will not refuse you—to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife."

verses.kjv: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
verses.modern: Bathsheba said, "Very well; I will speak for you to the king."

verses.kjv: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.modern: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him on behalf of Adonijah. And the king rose to meet her and bowed down to her. Then he sat on his throne and had a seat brought for the king's mother. She sat on his right hand.

verses.kjv: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
verses.modern: Then she said, "I have one small request to make of you; do not refuse me." And the king said to her, "Make your request, my mother, for I will not refuse you."

verses.kjv: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
verses.modern: She said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as his wife."

verses.kjv: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.modern: King Solomon answered his mother, "And why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my older brother, and on his side are Abiathar the priest and Joab the son of Zeruiah."

verses.kjv: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.modern: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, "God do so to me and more also if this word does not cost Adonijah his life!

verses.kjv: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.modern: Now therefore as the LORD lives, who has established me and placed me on the throne of David my father, and who has made me a house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death today."

verses.kjv: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.modern: So King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. He struck him down. He died.

verses.kjv: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.modern: To Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go to Anathoth, to your estate, for You deserve death. But I will not at this time put You to death, because You carried the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because you shared in all my father's affliction."

verses.kjv: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.modern: So Solomon expelled Abiathar from being priest to the LORD, thus fulfilling the word of the LORD that He had spoken concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

verses.kjv: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.modern: When the news came to Joab—for Joab had supported Adonijah although he had not supported Absalom—Joab fled to the tabernacle of the LORD and caught hold of the horns of the altar.

verses.kjv: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.modern: When it was told King Solomon, "Joab has fled to the tabernacle of the LORD. He is beside the altar," Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, "Go, strike him down."

verses.kjv: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.modern: So Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD and said to Him, "The king commands, 'Come out.' " But he said, "No, I will die here." Then Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, "Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me."

verses.kjv: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.modern: The king replied to him, "Do as he has said, strike him down and bury him, and thus take away from me and from my father's house the guilt for the blood that Joab shed without cause.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
verses.modern: The LORD will bring back His bloody deeds on His own head, because, without the knowledge of my father David, he attacked and killed with the sword two men more righteous and better than Himself, Abner the son of Ner, commander of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, commander of the army of Judah.

verses.kjv: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
verses.modern: So shall their blood come back on the head of Joab and on the head of his descendants forever. But for David and for his descendants and for his house and for His throne there shall be peace from the LORD forevermore."

verses.kjv: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.modern: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and struck him down and put Him to death. And He was buried in His own house in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.modern: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the army in place of Joab, and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.

verses.kjv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.modern: Then the king sent and summoned Shimei and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and dwell there, and do not go out from there to any place whatever.

verses.kjv: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
verses.modern: For on the day you go out and cross the brook Kidron, know for certain that you shall die. Your blood shall be on your own head."

verses.kjv: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.modern: Shimei said to the king, "What you say is good; as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do." So Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
verses.modern: But at the end of three years two of Shimei's servants ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And when it was told Shimei, "See, your servants are in Gath,"

verses.kjv: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.modern: Shimei arose and saddled a donkey and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants. He went and brought his servants back from Gath.

verses.kjv: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.modern: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and returned,

verses.kjv: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
verses.modern: The king sent and summoned Shimei and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the LORD and solemnly warn You, saying, 'Know for certain that on the day You go out and go to any place whatever, You shall surely die'? And You said to me, 'What You say is good; I will obey.'

verses.kjv: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
verses.modern: Why then have You not kept Your oath to the LORD and the commandment with which I charged You?"

verses.kjv: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
verses.modern: The king also said to Shimei, "You know in your own heart all the harm that you did to David my father. So the LORD will bring back your harm on Your own head.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
verses.modern: But King Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD forever."

verses.kjv: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.modern: Then the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. He went out and struck him down. He died. So the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

chapters.summary: David charged Solomon to walk in the LORD's ways and gave instructions regarding Joab, Shimei, and others before dying after a forty-year reign. Solomon consolidated his rule by executing Adonijah, Joab, and Shimei, and removing Abiathar from the priesthood.

verses.kjv: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.modern: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh's daughter and brought her into the city of David until he had finished building his own house and the house of the LORD and the wall around Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
verses.modern: The people were sacrificing at the high places, however, because no house had yet been built for the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.modern: Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father, only he sacrificed and made offerings at the high places.

verses.kjv: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.modern: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon used to offer a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

verses.kjv: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.modern: At Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night. God said, "Ask what I shall give You."

verses.kjv: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.modern: Solomon said, "You have shown great mercy to your servant David my father, because he walked before you in faithfulness, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart toward you. And you have kept for him this great mercy and have given him a son to sit on his throne this day.

verses.kjv: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
verses.modern: Now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in place of David my father, although I am but a little child. I do not know how to go out or come in.

verses.kjv: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.modern: Your servant is in the midst of Your people whom You have chosen, a great people, too many to be numbered or counted.

verses.kjv: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verses.modern: Give Your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern Your people, that I may discern between good and evil, for who is able to govern this Your great people?"

verses.kjv: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.modern: It pleased the Lord that Solomon had asked this.

verses.kjv: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
verses.modern: God said to Him, "Because you have asked this, and have not asked for yourself long life or riches or the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern what is right,

verses.kjv: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.modern: See, I now do according to your word. See, I give you a wise and discerning mind, so that none like you has been before you and none like you shall arise after you.

verses.kjv: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
verses.modern: I give you also what you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that no other king shall compare with you, all your days.

verses.kjv: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.modern: If you will walk in my ways, keeping my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days."

verses.kjv: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.modern: Solomon awoke. It was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings, and made a feast for all His servants.

verses.kjv: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.modern: Then two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

verses.kjv: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.modern: The one woman said, "Oh, my lord, this woman and I live in the same house. I gave birth to a child while she was in the house.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.modern: Then on the third day after I gave birth, this woman also gave birth. And we were alone. There was no one else with us in the house; only we two were in the house.

verses.kjv: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.modern: This woman's son died in the night, because she lay on him.

verses.kjv: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.modern: She arose at midnight and took my son from beside me, while your servant slept, and laid him at her breast, and laid her dead son at my breast.

verses.kjv: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.modern: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, he was dead. But when I looked at him closely in the morning, he was not the child that I had borne."

verses.kjv: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.modern: But the other woman said, "No, the living child is mine, and the dead child is yours." The first said, "No, the dead child is yours, and the living child is mine." Thus they spoke before the king.

verses.kjv: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
verses.modern: Then the king said, "The one says, 'This is my son that is alive, and your son is dead,' and the other says, 'No; but your son is dead, and my son is the living one.' "

verses.kjv: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.modern: The king said, "Bring me a sword." So a sword was brought before the king.

verses.kjv: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.modern: The king said, "Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one and half to the other."

verses.kjv: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
verses.modern: Then the woman whose son was alive said to the king, because her heart yearned for her son, "Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and by no means put him to death." But the other said, "He shall be neither mine nor yours; divide him."

verses.kjv: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
verses.modern: Then the king answered and said, "Give the living child to the first woman, and by no means put him to death; she is his mother."

verses.kjv: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
verses.modern: All Israel heard of the judgment that the king had rendered. They stood in awe of the king, because they saw that the wisdom of God was in Him to do justice.

chapters.summary: The LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream at Gibeon and offered him whatever he wished; Solomon asked for wisdom. God gave him unmatched wisdom and also riches and honor; Solomon demonstrated his wisdom by discerning the true mother of a disputed child.

verses.kjv: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.modern: King Solomon was king over all Israel,

verses.kjv: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
verses.modern: These were his high officials: Azariah the son of Zadok was the priest;

verses.kjv: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
verses.modern: Elihoreph and Ahijah the sons of Shisha were secretaries; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.modern: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was in command of the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

verses.kjv: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
verses.modern: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer and king's friend;

verses.kjv: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
verses.modern: Ahishar was in charge of the palace. Adoniram the son of Abda was in charge of the forced labor.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.modern: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for one month in the year.

verses.kjv: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
verses.modern: These were their names: The son of Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;

verses.kjv: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
verses.modern: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;

verses.kjv: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
verses.modern: The son of Hesed, in Arubboth (to him belonged Socoh and all the land of Hepher);

verses.kjv: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.modern: The son of Abinadab, in all Naphath-dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as his wife);

verses.kjv: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
verses.modern: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach, Megiddo. All Beth-shean that is beside Zarethan below Jezreel, and from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as the other side of Jokmeam;

verses.kjv: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
verses.modern: The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead (he had the villages of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead. He had the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);

verses.kjv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
verses.modern: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

verses.kjv: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
verses.modern: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he had taken Basmath the daughter of Solomon as his wife);

verses.kjv: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
verses.modern: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

verses.kjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
verses.modern: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

verses.kjv: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
verses.modern: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

verses.kjv: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
verses.modern: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan. And there was one governor who was over the land.

verses.kjv: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.modern: Judah and Israel were as many as the sand by the sea. They ate and drank and were happy.

verses.kjv: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.modern: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the river to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

verses.kjv: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.modern: Solomon's provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour and sixty cors of meal,

verses.kjv: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.modern: Ten fat oxen, and twenty pasture-fed cattle, a hundred sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.

verses.kjv: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.modern: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river. And he had peace on all sides around him.

verses.kjv: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.modern: Judah and Israel lived in safety, from Dan even to Beersheba, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, all the days of Solomon.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.modern: Solomon also had 4,000 stalls of horses for his chariots and 12,000 horsemen.

verses.kjv: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.modern: Those officers supplied provisions for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon's table, each one in his month. They let nothing be lacking.

verses.kjv: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
verses.modern: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds they brought to the place where it was required, each according to his duty.

verses.kjv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
verses.modern: God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding beyond measure, and breadth of mind like the sand on the seashore,

verses.kjv: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.modern: So that Solomon's wisdom surpassed the wisdom of all the people of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

verses.kjv: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.modern: For he was wiser than all other men, wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol. His fame was in all the surrounding nations.

verses.kjv: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.modern: He also spoke 3,000 proverbs. His songs were 1,005.

verses.kjv: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.modern: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of the wall. He spoke also of beasts, and of birds, and of reptiles, and of fish.

verses.kjv: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.modern: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and from all the kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.

chapters.summary: Solomon's officials and governors are listed, and his kingdom extended from the Euphrates to Egypt. Israel lived in safety, and Solomon's wisdom exceeded all the wisdom of the east; he spoke 3,000 proverbs and 1,005 songs.

verses.kjv: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.modern: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon when he heard that they had anointed him king in place of his father, for Hiram always loved David.

verses.kjv: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.modern: Solomon sent word to Hiram,

verses.kjv: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.modern: "You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the LORD His God because of the warfare with which His enemies surrounded Him, until the LORD put them under the soles of His feet.

verses.kjv: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.modern: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side. There is neither adversary nor misfortune.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
verses.modern: So I intend to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD said to David my father, 'Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place, shall build the house for my name.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.modern: Now therefore command that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. And my servants will join Your servants. I will pay You for Your servants whatever wages You set, for You know that there is no one among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.modern: As soon as Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly and said, "Blessed be the LORD this day, who has given to David a wise son to be over this great people."

verses.kjv: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.modern: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, "I have heard the message you sent to me. I am ready to do all you desire in the matter of cedar and cypress timber.

verses.kjv: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.modern: My servants shall bring it down to the sea from Lebanon. I will make it into rafts to go by sea to the place you direct. And I will have them broken up there, and you shall receive it. And you shall meet my wishes by providing food for my household."

verses.kjv: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
verses.modern: So Hiram supplied Solomon with all the timber of cedar and cypress that he desired,

verses.kjv: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.modern: While Solomon gave Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, and 20,000 cors of beaten oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

verses.kjv: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.modern: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. And there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.modern: King Solomon drafted forced labor out of all Israel, and the draft numbered 30,000 men.

verses.kjv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.modern: He sent them to Lebanon, 10,000 a month in shifts. They would be a month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

verses.kjv: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.modern: Solomon also had 70,000 burden-bearers and 80,000 stonecutters in the hill country,

verses.kjv: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.modern: Besides Solomon's 3,300 chief officers who were over the work, who had charge of the people who carried on the work.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
verses.modern: At the king's command they quarried out great, costly stones in order to lay the foundation of the house with dressed stones.

verses.kjv: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
verses.modern: So Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders and the men of Gebal did the cutting and prepared the timber and the stone to build the house.

chapters.summary: Solomon made an alliance with Hiram king of Tyre to supply cedar and cypress timber for the temple. Solomon conscripted laborers from Israel and sent them in shifts to Lebanon, along with stonecutters for the foundation.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
verses.modern: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the people of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, which is the second month, He began to build the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.modern: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.

verses.kjv: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.modern: The vestibule in front of the nave of the house was twenty cubits long, equal to the width of the house, and ten cubits deep in front of the house.

verses.kjv: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
verses.modern: He made for the house windows with recessed frames.

verses.kjv: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
verses.modern: He also built a structure against the wall of the house, running around the walls of the house, both the nave and the inner sanctuary. And He made side chambers all around.

verses.kjv: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened into the walls of the house.
verses.modern: The lowest story was five cubits wide, the middle one was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide. For around the outside of the house He made offsets on the wall in order that the supporting beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

verses.kjv: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.modern: When the house was built, it was with stone prepared at the quarry, so that neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was being built.

verses.kjv: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
verses.modern: The entrance for the lowest story was on the south side of the house, and one went up by stairs to the middle story, and from the middle story to the third.

verses.kjv: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
verses.modern: So He built the house and finished it. He made the ceiling of the house of beams and planks of cedar.

verses.kjv: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
verses.modern: He built the structure against the whole house, each story five cubits high. It was joined to the house with timbers of cedar.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
verses.modern: Now the word of the LORD came to Solomon,

verses.kjv: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
verses.modern: "Concerning this house that you are building, if you will walk in my statutes and obey my rules and keep all my commandments and walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

verses.kjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
verses.modern: I will dwell among the children of Israel and will not forsake my people Israel."

verses.kjv: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.modern: So Solomon built the house and finished it.

verses.kjv: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
verses.modern: He lined the walls of the house on the inside with boards of cedar. From the floor of the house to the rafters of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with boards of cypress.

verses.kjv: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
verses.modern: He built twenty cubits of the rear of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the rafters. He built this within as an inner sanctuary, as the Most Holy Place.

verses.kjv: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
verses.modern: The house, that is, the nave in front of the inner sanctuary, was forty cubits long.

verses.kjv: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.modern: The cedar within the house was carved in the form of gourds and open flowers. All was cedar; no stone was seen.

verses.kjv: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
verses.modern: The inner sanctuary He prepared in the innermost part of the house, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
verses.modern: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high. He overlaid it with pure gold. He also overlaid an altar of cedar.

verses.kjv: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.modern: Solomon overlaid the inside of the house with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across, in front of the inner sanctuary, and overlaid it with gold.

verses.kjv: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
verses.modern: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. Also the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary he overlaid with gold.

verses.kjv: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
verses.modern: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olivewood, each ten cubits high.

verses.kjv: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
verses.modern: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the length of the other wing of the cherub; it was ten cubits from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other.

verses.kjv: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
verses.modern: The other cherub also measured ten cubits; both cherubim had the same measure and the same form.

verses.kjv: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
verses.modern: The height of one cherub was ten cubits, and so was the other cherub.

verses.kjv: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
verses.modern: He put the cherubim in the innermost part of the house. And the wings of the cherubim were spread out so that a wing of one touched the one wall, and a wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; their other wings touched each other in the middle of the house.

verses.kjv: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
verses.modern: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

verses.kjv: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
verses.modern: Around all the walls of the house he carved engraved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, in the inner and outer rooms.

verses.kjv: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
verses.modern: The floor of the house he overlaid with gold in the inner and outer rooms.

verses.kjv: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
verses.modern: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary he made doors of olivewood; the lintel and the doorposts formed a pentagonal frame.

verses.kjv: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
verses.modern: He covered the two doors of olivewood with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers. He overlaid them with gold and spread gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

verses.kjv: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
verses.modern: So also he made for the entrance to the nave doorposts of olivewood, in the form of a square,

verses.kjv: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.modern: Two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

verses.kjv: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.modern: On them he carved cherubim and palm trees and open flowers. He overlaid them with gold evenly applied on the carved work.

verses.kjv: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.modern: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and one course of cedar beams.

verses.kjv: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
verses.modern: In the fourth year the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid, in the month of Ziv.

verses.kjv: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.modern: In the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished in all its parts, and according to all its specifications. He was seven years in building it.

chapters.summary: Solomon began building the temple in the fourth year of his reign, 480 years after the Exodus. The LORD promised to dwell among Israel if Solomon obeyed His statutes; the temple was completed in seven years, overlaid inside with gold.

verses.kjv: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.modern: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years. He finished his entire house.

verses.kjv: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.modern: He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was a hundred cubits and its breadth fifty cubits and its height thirty cubits. It was built on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

verses.kjv: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.modern: It was covered with cedar above the chambers that were on the forty-five pillars, fifteen in each row.

verses.kjv: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.modern: There were window frames in three rows, and window opposite window in three tiers.

verses.kjv: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.modern: All the doorways and windows had square frames, and window was opposite window in three tiers.

verses.kjv: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
verses.modern: He made the Hall of Pillars; its length was fifty cubits, and its breadth thirty cubits. There was a porch in front with pillars, and a canopy in front of them.

verses.kjv: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
verses.modern: He made the Hall of the Throne where he was to pronounce judgment, even the Hall of Judgment. It was finished with cedar from floor to rafters.

verses.kjv: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
verses.modern: His own house where he was to dwell, in the other court back of the hall, was of like workmanship. Solomon also made a house like this hall for Pharaoh's daughter whom he had taken in marriage.

verses.kjv: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
verses.modern: All these were made of costly stones, cut according to measure, sawed with saws, back and front, even from the foundation to the coping, and from the outside to the great court.

verses.kjv: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.modern: The foundation was of costly stones, huge stones, stones of eight and ten cubits.

verses.kjv: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.modern: Above were costly stones, cut according to measurement, and cedar.

verses.kjv: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
verses.modern: The great court had three courses of cut stone all around and a course of cedar beams; so had the inner court of the house of the LORD and the vestibule of the house.

verses.kjv: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.modern: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram from Tyre.

verses.kjv: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.modern: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali. His father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze. And he was full of wisdom, understanding, and skill for making any work in bronze. He came to King Solomon and did all his work.

verses.kjv: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
verses.modern: He cast two pillars of bronze. Eighteen cubits was the height of one pillar, and a line of twelve cubits measured its circumference.

verses.kjv: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
verses.modern: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

verses.kjv: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.modern: There were lattices of checker work with wreaths of chain work for the capitals on the tops of the pillars, a lattice for the one capital and a lattice for the other capital.

verses.kjv: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.modern: Likewise he made pomegranates in two rows around the one latticework to cover the capital that was on the top of the one pillar. He did the same with the other capital.

verses.kjv: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.modern: Now the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars in the vestibule were of lily-work, four cubits.

verses.kjv: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.modern: The capitals were on the two pillars and also above the rounded projection that was beside the lattice-work. There were 200 pomegranates in two rows around each capital.

verses.kjv: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.modern: He set up the pillars at the vestibule of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin. He set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.

verses.kjv: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.modern: On the tops of the pillars was lily-work. Thus the work of the pillars was finished.

verses.kjv: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.modern: Then he made the sea of cast metal. It was round, ten cubits from brim to brim, and five cubits high, and a line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.

verses.kjv: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.modern: Under its brim were gourds, for ten cubits, compassing the sea all around. The gourds were in two rows, cast with it when it was cast.

verses.kjv: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.modern: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The sea was set on them. All their rear parts were inward.

verses.kjv: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.modern: Its thickness was a handbreadth, and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

verses.kjv: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.modern: He also made the ten stands of bronze. Each stand was four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.

verses.kjv: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
verses.modern: This was the construction of the stands: they had panels, and the panels were set in the frames,

verses.kjv: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
verses.modern: On the panels that were set in the frames were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the frames, both above and below the lions and oxen, there were wreaths of hanging work.

verses.kjv: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.modern: Each stand had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze, and at the four corners were supports for a basin. The supports were cast with wreaths at the side of each.

verses.kjv: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.modern: Its opening was within the crown and above it was a cubit high; its opening was round, as a pedestal is made, a cubit and a half deep. At its opening there were carvings, and its panels were square, not round.

verses.kjv: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
