verses.modern: Their father said to them, "Which way did he go?" And his sons showed him the way that the man of God Who came from Judah had gone.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.modern: He said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled the donkey for him and he mounted it.

verses.kjv: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
verses.modern: He went after the man of God and found Him sitting under an oak. And He said to Him, "Are you the man of God Who came from Judah?" And He said, "I am."

verses.kjv: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.modern: Then he said to him, "Come home with me and eat bread."

verses.kjv: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
verses.modern: He said, "I may not return with you, or go in with you, neither will I eat bread nor drink water with you in this place,

verses.kjv: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
verses.modern: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, 'You shall neither eat bread nor drink water there, nor return by the way that You came.' "

verses.kjv: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
verses.modern: He said to Him, "I also am a prophet as You are, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, 'Bring Him back with You into Your house that He may eat bread and drink water.' " But He lied to Him.

verses.kjv: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.modern: So He went back with Him and ate bread in His house and drank water.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.modern: As they sat at the table, the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back.

verses.kjv: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
verses.modern: He cried to the man of God Who came from Judah, "Thus says the LORD, 'Because You have disobeyed the word of the LORD and have not kept the command that the LORD Your God commanded You,

verses.kjv: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
verses.modern: But have come back and have eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which He said to You, "Eat no bread and drink no water," your body shall not come to the tomb of Your fathers.' "

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.modern: After he had eaten bread and drunk, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

verses.kjv: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.modern: As he went away a lion met him on the road and killed him. And his body was thrown in the road, and the donkey stood beside it; the lion also stood beside the body.

verses.kjv: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.modern: People passed by and saw the body thrown in the road and the lion standing by the body. And they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

verses.kjv: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
verses.modern: When the prophet who had brought him back from the way heard of it, He said, "It is the man of God Who disobeyed the word of the LORD; therefore the LORD has given Him to the lion, which has torn Him and killed Him, according to the word that the LORD spoke to Him."

verses.kjv: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
verses.modern: He said to His sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." And they saddled it.

verses.kjv: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.modern: He went and found His body thrown in the road, and the donkey and the lion standing beside the body. The lion had not eaten the body or torn the donkey.

verses.kjv: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.modern: The prophet took up the body of the man of God and laid it on the donkey and brought it back to the city to mourn and to bury Him.

verses.kjv: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
verses.modern: He laid the body in his own grave. And they mourned over him, saying, "Alas, my brother!"

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.modern: After he had buried him, he said to his sons, "When I die, bury me in the grave in which the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside His bones.

verses.kjv: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.modern: For the saying that He cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel and against all the houses of the high places that are in the cities of Samaria shall surely come to pass."

verses.kjv: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.modern: After this thing Jeroboam did not turn from his evil way, but made priests for the high places again from among all the people. Any who would, he ordained as priests of the high places.

verses.kjv: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.modern: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, so as to cut it off and to destroy it from the face of the earth.

chapters.summary: A man of God from Judah prophesied against Jeroboam's altar at Bethel, and the altar was torn apart as a sign. The prophet was deceived by an old prophet into disobedience and was killed by a lion on the road.

verses.kjv: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.modern: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
verses.modern: Jeroboam said to his wife, "Arise, and disguise yourself, that it not be known that you are the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh. Ahijah the prophet is there, who said of me that I should be king over this people.

verses.kjv: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
verses.modern: Take with you ten loaves, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what shall happen to the child."

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.modern: Jeroboam's wife did so. She arose and went to Shiloh and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were dim because of his age.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Ahijah, " the wife of Jeroboam is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for He is sick. Thus and so shall You say to her." When she came, she pretended to be another woman.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
verses.modern: But when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why do you pretend to be another? For I am charged with harsh news for you.

verses.kjv: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
verses.modern: Go, tell Jeroboam, 'Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: "Because I exalted You from among the people and made you leader over my people Israel

verses.kjv: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;
verses.modern: Tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, and yet you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commandments and followed me with all his heart, doing only that which was right in my eyes,

verses.kjv: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
verses.modern: But you have done evil above all who were before you and have gone and made for yourself other gods and metal images, provoking me to anger, and have cast me behind your back—

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
verses.modern: Therefore I will bring harm upon the house of Jeroboam and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, both bond and free in Israel, and will burn up the house of Jeroboam, as a man burns up dung until it is all gone.

verses.kjv: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verses.modern: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city the dogs shall eat, and anyone who dies in the open country the birds of the heavens shall eat, for the LORD has spoken it."'

verses.kjv: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
verses.modern: Arise therefore, go to Your house. When Your feet enter the city, the child shall die.

verses.kjv: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.modern: All Israel shall mourn for Him and bury Him, for He only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found something pleasing to the LORD, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
verses.modern: Moreover, the LORD will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam today. And henceforth,

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.
verses.modern: The LORD will strike Israel as a reed is shaken in the water, and root up Israel out of this good land that He gave to their fathers and scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.

verses.kjv: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
verses.modern: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he sinned and made Israel to sin."

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
verses.modern: Then Jeroboam's wife arose and departed and came to Tirzah. And as she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

verses.kjv: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.modern: They buried Him. All Israel mourned for Him, according to the word of the LORD, which He spoke by His servant Ahijah the prophet.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred and how he reigned, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: The time that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years. And he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.modern: Now Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there. His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.

verses.kjv: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
verses.modern: Judah did what was evil in the sight of the LORD. They provoked Him to jealousy with their sins that they committed, more than all that their fathers had done.

verses.kjv: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
verses.modern: For they also built for themselves high places and images and groves on every high hill and under every green tree,

verses.kjv: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.modern: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations that the LORD drove out before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
verses.modern: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.modern: He took away the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king's house. He took away everything. He also took away all the shields of gold that Solomon had made,

verses.kjv: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.
verses.modern: King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze, and committed them to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
verses.modern: As often as the king went into the house of the LORD, the guard carried them and brought them back to the guardroom.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
verses.modern: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

verses.kjv: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite. And Abijam his son reigned in his place.

chapters.summary: Jeroboam's son fell ill, and the prophet Ahijah told Jeroboam's wife that the child would die and the house of Jeroboam would be cut off. Rehoboam reigned in Judah and did evil; Shishak king of Egypt plundered the temple treasures.

verses.kjv: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
verses.modern: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

verses.kjv: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.modern: He reigned for three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.kjv: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
verses.modern: He walked in all the sins that His father did before Him. His heart was not wholly true to the LORD His God, as the heart of David his father.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless for David's sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
verses.modern: Nevertheless, for David's sake the LORD His God gave Him a lamp in Jerusalem, setting up His son after Him, and establishing Jerusalem,

verses.kjv: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.modern: Because David did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and did not turn aside from anything that He commanded Him all the days of His life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.kjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.modern: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.modern: The rest of the acts of Abijam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

verses.kjv: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Abijam slept with his fathers. They buried him in the city of David. And Asa his son reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
verses.modern: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah,

verses.kjv: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.modern: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.kjv: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.
verses.modern: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as David his father had done.

verses.kjv: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.modern: He put away the sodomites out of the land and removed all the idols that His fathers had made.

verses.kjv: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
verses.modern: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen mother because she had made an idol in a grove. And Asa destroyed her idol and burned it at the brook Kidron.

verses.kjv: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
verses.modern: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless, the heart of Asa was wholly true to the LORD all His days.

verses.kjv: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.modern: He brought into the house of the LORD the sacred gifts of His father and His own sacred gifts, silver, and gold, and vessels.

verses.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.modern: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.kjv: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.modern: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and built Ramah, that he might permit no one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.kjv: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.modern: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king's house and gave them into the hands of his servants. And King Asa sent them to Ben-hadad the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived in Damascus, saying,

verses.kjv: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.modern: "Let there be a covenant between me and You, as there was between my father and Your father. I am sending to You a present of silver and gold. Go, break Your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, that He may withdraw from me."

verses.kjv: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.modern: Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel and struck Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah. All Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.modern: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah and lived in Tirzah.

verses.kjv: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.modern: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah, none was exempt. They carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber, with which Baasha had been building, and with them King Asa built Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah.

verses.kjv: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.modern: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, all his might. All that he did, and the cities that he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? But in his old age he was diseased in his feet.

verses.kjv: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Asa slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father, and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
verses.modern: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah. He reigned over Israel two years.

verses.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.modern: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of His father, and in His sin which He made Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.modern: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against Him. And Baasha struck Him down at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines, for Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to Gibbethon.

verses.kjv: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: So Baasha killed him in the third year of Asa king of Judah and reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
verses.modern: As soon as He was king, He killed all the house of Jeroboam. He left to the house of Jeroboam not one that breathed, until he had destroyed it, according to the word of the LORD that He spoke by His servant Ahijah the Shilonite.

verses.kjv: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.
verses.modern: It was for the sins of Jeroboam that he sinned and that he made Israel to sin, and because of the anger to which He provoked the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab and all that He did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.modern: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.kjv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
verses.modern: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel at Tirzah. He reigned twenty-four years.

verses.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.modern: He did what was evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin which he made Israel to sin.

chapters.summary: Abijam reigned over Judah and walked in his father's sins, but Asa his son did right, removing idols and deposing his grandmother Maacah. In Israel, Nadab son of Jeroboam was assassinated by Baasha, who continued in Jeroboam's sin.

verses.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
verses.modern: "Since I exalted you out of the dust and made you leader over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, provoking me to anger with their sins,

verses.kjv: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.modern: I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house. I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.kjv: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.modern: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city the dogs shall eat, and anyone of his who dies in the field the birds of the heavens shall eat."

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha and what he did. His might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried at Tirzah, and Elah his son reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
verses.modern: Moreover, the word of the LORD came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and his house, both because of all the evil that He did in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger with the work of His hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and also because he destroyed it.

verses.kjv: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
verses.modern: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah. He reigned two years.

verses.kjv: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
verses.modern: But his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him. When he was at Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah,

verses.kjv: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Zimri came in and struck him down and killed him, in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
verses.modern: When he began to reign, as soon as he had seated himself on his throne, he struck down all the house of Baasha. He did not leave him one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsmen nor of his friends.

verses.kjv: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
verses.modern: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which He spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

verses.kjv: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.modern: For all the sins of Baasha and the sins of Elah His son, which they sinned and which they made Israel to sin, provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their idols.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Elah and all that He did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.modern: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the troops were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines,

verses.kjv: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.modern: The troops who were encamped heard it said, "Zimri has conspired. He has also struck down the king." Therefore all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

verses.kjv: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.modern: So Omri went up from Gibbethon. All Israel with him. They besieged Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died.
verses.modern: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the king's house and burned the king's house over him with fire and died,

verses.kjv: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
verses.modern: Because of His sins that He committed, doing evil in the sight of the LORD, walking in the way of Jeroboam, and for his sin which he committed, making Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the conspiracy that He made, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
verses.modern: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts. Half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

verses.kjv: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.modern: But the people who followed Omri overcame the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. So Tibni died, and Omri became king.

verses.kjv: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
verses.modern: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel. He reigned for twelve years; six years he reigned at Tirzah.

verses.kjv: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
verses.modern: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver. He fortified the hill and called the name of the city that he built Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

verses.kjv: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.
verses.modern: Omri did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, and did more evil than all who were before Him.

verses.kjv: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
verses.modern: For He walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in the sins that he made Israel to sin, provoking the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger by their idols.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.modern: Now the rest of the acts of Omri that he did, and the might that he showed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Omri slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
verses.modern: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel, and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

verses.kjv: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.
verses.modern: Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD, more than all who were before Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
verses.modern: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took for his wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

verses.kjv: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.modern: He erected an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which He built in Samaria.

verses.kjv: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.modern: Ahab made a grove. Ahab did more to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before Him.

verses.kjv: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.modern: In His days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho. He laid its foundation at the cost of Abiram His firstborn, and set up its gates at the cost of His youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which He spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

chapters.summary: Baasha's house was condemned by the prophet Jehu, and his son Elah was assassinated by Zimri, who reigned only seven days before Omri took power. Omri built Samaria, and his son Ahab married Jezebel and served Baal, doing more evil than all the kings before him.

verses.kjv: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.modern: Now Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word."

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.modern: The word of the LORD came to Him:

verses.kjv: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.modern: "Depart from here and turn eastward and hide Yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
verses.modern: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed You there."

verses.kjv: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.modern: So He went and did according to the word of the LORD. He went and lived by the brook Cherith that is east of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.modern: The ravens brought Him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening. He drank from the brook.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.modern: After a while the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

verses.kjv: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to Him,

verses.kjv: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
verses.modern: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there. I have commanded a widow there to feed You."

verses.kjv: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.modern: So He arose and went to Zarephath. And when He came to the gate of the city, a widow was there gathering sticks. And He called to her and said, "Bring me a little water in a vessel, that I may drink."

verses.kjv: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
verses.modern: As she was going to bring it, He called to her and said, "Bring me a morsel of bread in Your hand."

verses.kjv: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.modern: She said, "As the LORD Your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. And now I am gathering a couple of sticks that I may go in and prepare it for myself and my son, that we may eat it and die."

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
verses.modern: Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go and do as you have said. But first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me, and afterward make something for yourself and your son.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
verses.modern: For thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, 'The jar of flour shall not be spent, and the jug of oil shall not be empty, until the day that the LORD sends rain upon the earth.' "

verses.kjv: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
verses.modern: She went and did as Elijah said. And she and he and her household ate for many days.

verses.kjv: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
verses.modern: The jar of flour was not spent, neither did the jug of oil become empty, according to the word of the LORD that He spoke by Elijah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.modern: After this the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became ill. And his illness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

verses.kjv: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
verses.modern: She said to Elijah, "What have you against me, O man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to remembrance and to cause the death of my son!"

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.modern: He said to her, "Give me your son." And he took him from her arms and carried him up into the upper chamber where he lodged, and laid him on his own bed.

verses.kjv: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.modern: He cried to the LORD, "O LORD my God, have You brought calamity even upon the widow with whom I stay, by killing her son?"

verses.kjv: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.
verses.modern: Then He stretched Himself upon the child three times and cried to the LORD, "O LORD my God, let this child's soul come into Him again."

verses.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.modern: The LORD listened to the voice of Elijah. And the soul of the child came into him again. He revived.

verses.kjv: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
verses.modern: Elijah took the child and brought him down from the upper chamber into the house and delivered him to his mother. And Elijah said, "See, your son lives."

verses.kjv: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.
verses.modern: The woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in your mouth is truth."

chapters.summary: Elijah the prophet declared a drought on Israel, and the LORD sent him to the brook Cherith where ravens fed him. When the brook dried up, God sent him to a widow at Zarephath whose flour and oil did not run out, and Elijah raised her dead son to life.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.modern: After many days the word of the LORD came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, "Go, show yourself to Ahab. I will send rain upon the earth."

verses.kjv: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
verses.modern: So Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria.

verses.kjv: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
verses.modern: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly,

verses.kjv: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.modern: When Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah took a hundred prophets and hid them by fifties in a cave and fed them with bread and water.)

verses.kjv: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.modern: Ahab said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs of water and to all the valleys. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, and not lose some of the animals."

verses.kjv: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.modern: So they divided the land between them to pass through it. Ahab went in one direction by himself, and Obadiah went in another direction by himself.

verses.kjv: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?
verses.modern: As Obadiah was on the way, Elijah met him. And Obadiah recognized him and fell on his face and said, "Is it you, my lord Elijah?"

verses.kjv: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.modern: He answered him, "It is I. Go, tell your lord, ' Elijah is here.' "

verses.kjv: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.modern: He said, "How have I sinned, that you would give your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

verses.kjv: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
verses.modern: As the LORD Your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek You. And when they would say, 'He is not here,' He would take an oath of the kingdom or nation, that they had not found You.

verses.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.modern: Now you say, 'Go, tell your lord, " Elijah is here."'

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
verses.modern: As soon as I have gone from You, the Spirit of the LORD will carry You I know not where. And so, when I come and tell Ahab and he cannot find you, he will kill me, although I Your servant have feared the LORD from my youth.

verses.kjv: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD'S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.modern: Has it not been told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, how I hid a hundred men of the LORD's prophets by fifties in a cave and fed them with bread and water?

verses.kjv: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
verses.modern: Now you say, 'Go, tell your lord, " Elijah is here"'. He will kill me."

verses.kjv: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
verses.modern: Elijah said, "As the LORD of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to Him today."

verses.kjv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.modern: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him. And Ahab went to meet Elijah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
verses.modern: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, "Is it you, you troubler of Israel?"

verses.kjv: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
verses.modern: He answered, "I have not troubled Israel, but You have, and Your father's house, because You have abandoned the commandments of the LORD and followed the Baals.

verses.kjv: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.
verses.modern: Now therefore send and gather all Israel to me at Mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, who eat at Jezebel's table."

verses.kjv: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.modern: So Ahab sent to all the people of Israel and gathered the prophets together at Mount Carmel.

verses.kjv: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.modern: Elijah came near to all the people and said, "How long will you halt between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow Him; but if Baal, then follow Him." And the people did not answer him a word.

verses.kjv: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.modern: Then Elijah said to the people, "I, even I only, am left a prophet of the LORD, but Baal's prophets are 450 men.

verses.kjv: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
verses.modern: Let two bulls be given to us, and let them choose one bull for themselves and cut it in pieces and lay it on the wood, but put no fire to it. And I will prepare the other bull and lay it on the wood and put no fire to it.

verses.kjv: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.modern: You call upon the name of Your god. I will call upon the name of the LORD, and the God Who answers by fire, He is God." And all the people answered, "It is well spoken."

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
verses.modern: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose for yourselves one bull and prepare it first, for you are many, and call upon the name of your god, but put no fire to it."

verses.kjv: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
verses.modern: They took the bull that was given them. They prepared it and called upon the name of Baal from morning until noon, saying, "O Baal, answer us!" But there was no voice, and no one answered. And they limped around the altar that they had made.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
verses.modern: At noon Elijah mocked them, saying, "Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either He is musing, or He is relieving himself, or He is on a journey, or perhaps He is asleep and must be awakened."

verses.kjv: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.modern: They cried aloud and cut themselves after their custom with swords and lances, until the blood gushed out upon them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.modern: As midday passed, they raved on until the time of the offering of the oblation, but there was no voice. No one answered; no one paid attention.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.
verses.modern: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come near to me." And all the people came near to him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that had been thrown down.

verses.kjv: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
verses.modern: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD came, saying, "Israel shall be Your name,"

verses.kjv: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.modern: With the stones He built an altar in the name of the LORD. And He made a trench around the altar, as great as would contain two seahs of seed.

verses.kjv: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
verses.modern: He put the wood in order and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. And He said, "Fill four jars with water and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood."

verses.kjv: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
verses.modern: He said, "Do it a second time." And they did it a second time. And He said, "Do it a third time." And they did it a third time.

verses.kjv: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.modern: The water ran around the altar and filled the trench also with water.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
verses.modern: At the time of the offering of the oblation, Elijah the prophet came near and said, "O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac. Israel, let it be known this day that you are God in Israel, and that I am Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your word.

verses.kjv: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.
verses.modern: Answer me, O LORD, answer me, that this people may know that You, O LORD, are God, and that You have turned their hearts back."

verses.kjv: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.modern: Then the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the burnt offering and the wood and the stones and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

verses.kjv: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is the God; the LORD, he is the God.
verses.modern: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces and said, "The LORD, He is God; the LORD, He is God."

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.modern: Elijah said to them, "Seize the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape." And they seized them. And Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon and slaughtered them there.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
verses.modern: Elijah said to Ahab, "Go up, eat and drink, for there is a sound of the rushing of rain."

verses.kjv: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
verses.modern: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Mount Carmel. And he bowed himself down on the earth and put his face between his knees.

verses.kjv: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.modern: He said to his servant, "Go up now, look toward the sea." And he went up and looked and said, "There is nothing." And he said, "Go again," seven times.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
verses.modern: At the seventh time he said, " a little cloud like a man's hand is rising from the sea." And he said, "Go up, say to Ahab, 'Prepare your chariot and go down, lest the rain stop you.' "

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.modern: In a little while the heavens grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode and went to Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.modern: The hand of the LORD was on Elijah. He gathered up his garment and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

chapters.summary: Elijah challenged the 450 prophets of Baal to a contest on Mount Carmel: the god who answered by fire would be the true God. The LORD consumed Elijah's sacrifice with fire; the people declared the LORD is God, and the prophets of Baal were slaughtered.

verses.kjv: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
verses.modern: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

verses.kjv: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
verses.modern: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, "So may the gods do to me and more also, if I do not make your life as the life of one of them by this time tomorrow."

verses.kjv: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
verses.modern: Then he was afraid. He arose and ran for his life and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

verses.kjv: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
verses.modern: But He Himself went a day's journey into the wilderness and came and sat down under a broom tree. And He asked that He might die, saying, "It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life, for I am no better than my fathers."

verses.kjv: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
verses.modern: He lay down and slept under a broom tree. And an angel touched Him and said to Him, "Arise and eat."

verses.kjv: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
verses.modern: He looked, and there was at His head a cake baked on hot stones and a jar of water. And He ate and drank and lay down again.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD came again a second time and touched Him and said, "Arise and eat, for the journey is too great for You."

verses.kjv: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
verses.modern: He arose and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, the mount of God.

verses.kjv: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.modern: There He came to a cave and lodged in it. And the word of the LORD came to Him. He said to Him, "What are You doing here, Elijah?"

verses.kjv: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.modern: He said, "I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of hosts. For the people of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left. They seek my life, to take it away."

verses.kjv: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake:
verses.modern: He said, "Go out and stand on the mount before the LORD." And the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD. But the LORD was not in the wind. And after the wind an earthquake. But the LORD was not in the earthquake.

verses.kjv: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
verses.modern: After the earthquake a fire. But the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire a still small voice.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
verses.modern: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his cloak and went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. And there came a voice to him and said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

verses.kjv: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.modern: He said, "I have been very jealous for the LORD, the God of hosts. For the people of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left. They seek my life, to take it away."

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
verses.modern: The LORD said to Him, "Go, return on Your way to the wilderness of Damascus. And when You arrive, You shall anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

verses.kjv: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.
verses.modern: Jehu the son of Nimshi you shall anoint to be king over Israel, and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah you shall anoint to be prophet in your place.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
verses.modern: The one who escapes from the sword of Hazael shall Jehu put to death, and the one who escapes from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha put to death.

verses.kjv: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
verses.modern: Yet I will leave seven thousand in Israel, all the knees that have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him."

verses.kjv: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
verses.modern: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen in front of him. He was with the twelfth. Elijah passed by him and cast his cloak upon him.

verses.kjv: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?
verses.modern: He left the oxen and ran after Elijah and said, "Let me kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you." And he said to him, "Go back again, for what have I done to you?"

verses.kjv: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
verses.modern: He returned from following him and took the yoke of oxen and sacrificed them and boiled their flesh with the yokes of the oxen and gave it to the people. They ate. Then he arose and went after Elijah and assisted him.

chapters.summary: Jezebel threatened to kill Elijah, and he fled to the wilderness in despair, asking God to take his life. The LORD came to him at Mount Horeb in a still small voice and commissioned him to anoint Hazael, Jehu, and Elisha.

verses.kjv: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
verses.modern: Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together. Thirty-two kings were with him, and horses and chariots. And he went up and besieged Samaria and fought against it.

verses.kjv: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,
verses.modern: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, "Thus says Ben-hadad:

verses.kjv: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
verses.modern: 'Your silver and your gold are mine; your wives and your children also are mine.' "

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
verses.modern: The king of Israel answered, "As you say, my lord, O king, I am yours. All that I have."

verses.kjv: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
verses.modern: The messengers came again and said, "Thus says Ben-hadad: 'I sent to you, saying, "Deliver to me your silver and your gold, your wives and your children."

verses.kjv: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
verses.modern: Nevertheless I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time. They shall search your house and the houses of your servants and lay hands on whatever pleases you and take it away.' "

verses.kjv: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
verses.modern: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land and said, "Mark, now, and see how this man is seeking trouble, for he sent to me for my wives and my children, and for my silver and my gold. I did not refuse him."

verses.kjv: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
verses.modern: All the elders and all the people said to him, "Do not listen or consent."

verses.kjv: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
verses.modern: So he said to the messengers of Ben-hadad, "Tell my lord the king, 'All that you first demanded of your servant I will do, but this thing I cannot do.' " And the messengers departed and brought him word again.

verses.kjv: And Benhadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
verses.modern: Ben-hadad sent to him and said, "The gods do so to me and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people who follow me."

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
verses.modern: The king of Israel answered, "Tell him, 'Let not him who straps on his armor boast himself as he who takes it off.' "

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Benhadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.
verses.modern: When Ben-hadad heard this message as he was drinking with the kings in the booths, he said to his men, "Take your positions." And they took their positions against the city.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.modern: A prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel and said, "Thus says the LORD, Have You seen all this great crowd? I will give it into Your hand this day, and You shall know that I am the LORD."

verses.kjv: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
verses.modern: Ahab said, "By whom?" He said, "Thus says the LORD, By the servants of the district governors." Then He said, "Who shall begin the battle?" He answered, "You."

verses.kjv: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
verses.modern: Then He mustered the servants of the district governors. They were 232. And after them He mustered all the people of Israel, seven thousand.

verses.kjv: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
verses.modern: They went out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking Himself drunk in the booths, He and the thirty-two kings who helped Him.

verses.kjv: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
verses.modern: The servants of the district governors went out first. And Ben-hadad sent out scouts. They reported to Him, "Men are coming out from Samaria."

verses.kjv: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
verses.modern: He said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive. Or if they have come out for war, take them alive."

verses.kjv: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
verses.modern: So these went out of the city, the servants of the district governors and the army that followed them.

verses.kjv: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
verses.modern: Each struck down His man. The Syrians fled. Israel pursued them, but Ben-hadad king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
verses.modern: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and struck the Syrians with a great blow.

verses.kjv: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.
verses.modern: Then the prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, "Come, strengthen yourself, and consider carefully what you should do, for in the spring the king of Syria will come up against you."

verses.kjv: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
verses.modern: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, "Their gods are gods of the hills, and so they were stronger than we. But let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

verses.kjv: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
verses.modern: Do this: remove the kings, each from his post, and put commanders in their places,

verses.kjv: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
verses.modern: Number an army like the army you lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot. Then we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they." And he listened to their voice and did so.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
